svg.title: Darkroom — assembled view
svg.desc: Sled in, four screw heads flush. All part offsets are exactly zero. Drawn from cad/darkroom.scad; not to scale.

g.text: Sled in, four screw heads flush. All part offsets are exactly zero.
front plate + floor + rails + rear bulkhead,

Concept geometry from cad/darkroom.scad (v0.4); not a fabrication drawing or a confirmed build. The microSD reader is a placeholder board; display and PiSugar fit,
